text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by their effect on the whole portfolio, not by whether a sale realizes a gain or loss; selling Stock B and Stock C below cost alone does not prove the decisions were wrong.","Avoid reacting to recent price moves with frequent switches. Before each trade, set a clear reason and consider how it fits the longer-term plan.","Keep enough diversification and cash to manage risk, and assess progress against the overall market over many periods rather than drawing conclusions from short-term account changes."]}
